description: A random number generator for any range, in your browser. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

count.description: How many numbers to draw, up to 1000. Always returned as an array.

max.description: Highest whole number that may be drawn, inclusive. Must not be below `min`. 100 when omitted.

min.description: Lowest whole number that may be drawn, inclusive. 1 when omitted.

sorted.description: Return the draw in ascending order. Sorting happens after drawing, so it does not change the odds.

unique.description: Draw without repeats, like lottery balls rather than dice. Refused if `count` is more than the range holds.

name: random_number_generator
title: Random Number Generator
